Question: Draw an ER diagram for a University system where a Student enrolls in a College. A College has specialization into Computer Science, Mechanical, and Electronics departments.

Entities:
1. Student - Rectangle
   Attributes: Name, Gender, DOB, Age (derived - dashed ellipse)

2. College - Rectangle
   Attributes: Name, Affiliation, Address

3. Computer Science - Rectangle
4. Mechanical - Rectangle
5. Electronics - Rectangle

Relationships:
- Enrolls in (diamond) connecting Student and College
- Specialized in (diamond) connecting College to Computer Science, Mechanical, Electronics

Connections:
- Student --(Enrolls in)--> College
- College --(Specialized in)--> Computer Science
- College --(Specialized in)--> Mechanical
- College --(Specialized in)--> Electronics

All attributes connected to their respective entities with lines. Age attribute shown as dashed ellipse to indicate derived attribute.

evaluation.justification: Excellent ER diagram covering all required entities, attributes, and relationships. All notation is correct.
evaluation.feedback: Very well done. Minor improvement could be made to the clarity of attribute connections.
